_schema_note: Every field except 'opener' is your real proven copy from the 16-template playbook, substituted verbatim every time — the proof point, the offer, and the CTA never change and are never AI-generated, so quality can't drift. 'opener' is the one variable sentence: built deterministically first (grammar-safe by construction, works for any shape of research detail), with AI given one validated attempt to upgrade it to more natural prose. 'detail_fallback' is only used when a lead has neither Trigger nor Pain Point filled in. real_estate additionally supports solo-vs-team stat/proof selection via each lead's Business Type column.

real_estate.opener_example: Saw InvesTeam Realty has active listings in Doral.
real_estate.team_stat_block: Most teams your size respond to new leads in 15+ hours — by then, the average buyer has already called two other agents.
real_estate.solo_stat_block: Solo agents juggling their own showings often can't respond to a new lead the moment it comes in — and by the time you do, the average buyer has already called two other agents.
real_estate.team_proof_block: One team recovered 12+ additional viewings a month without adding an ISA.
real_estate.solo_proof_block: A solo agent in a comparable market picked up meaningful extra viewing capacity without hiring an assistant.
